transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. AI. What brings you in today?

Hello, Doctor. I'm here because I've been really struggling with these constant, intrusive thoughts that I just can't seem to get out of my head. They are incredibly distressing and feel completely out of my control, and I really need help managing them.
When these intrusive thoughts happen, do you do anything to try to neutralize them, like repeated checking, cleaning, counting, or mental rituals?
I'm not really sure if I do things like that. Mostly, I just feel completely overwhelmed by the thoughts themselves, so I don't think I have any specific rituals.
Have these thoughts been tied to a traumatic event, with symptoms like flashbacks, nightmares, or feeling on edge when reminded of it?

No, these thoughts aren't tied to any kind of traumatic event at all. I don't experience flashbacks, nightmares, or feel on edge from past trauma. They just seem to pop into my head completely out of nowhere.
Over the past two weeks, have you been feeling down, depressed, or lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?
No, I haven't been feeling depressed or down, and I haven't lost interest in the things I usually enjoy. It's really just these distressing, intrusive thoughts that are bothering me.
Do you recognize these thoughts as unreasonable or unwanted, even though they keep coming back?

Yes, I absolutely recognize that these thoughts are completely unreasonable and unwanted, which actually makes them even more distressing. No matter how hard I try to ignore them, I find it completely impossible to stop them from constantly returning to my mind.
How much are these thoughts affecting your daily life, like work, school, relationships, or sleep?

These thoughts are incredibly distracting and take up a huge amount of my time every day. I'm not really sure how to measure their exact impact on things like my work, relationships, or sleep, but they definitely make it hard to focus on anything else.
About how much time each day do these intrusive thoughts take up?
I'm not really sure of the exact number of hours they take up, as I've never actually timed it. However, they do feel incredibly frequent and seem to be there throughout most of my day.
How long have you been dealing with these intrusive thoughts?
I'm not entirely sure of the exact timeline, to be honest. They have been happening for quite a while now, but I just can't pinpoint exactly when they first started.
Do you remember whether these thoughts have been going on for more than a month, or did they start more recently?
I'm really not sure of the exact timeframe, but it definitely feels like it has been much longer than a month. I just can't remember when it officially started.
Do you remember whether these thoughts have been going on for more than a month, or did they start more recently?
I'm really not quite sure exactly when it all started or how long it has been going on. I haven't kept close track of the timeline, so it's hard for me to give you a specific timeframe.
